description: This file defines a Flutter widget class `RecipeCard` that displays a recipe's image, title, description, tags, and save status. It includes user interactions for navigation to recipe details and toggling saved status, utilizing provider state management.

classes.name: RecipeCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that renders a card UI for a recipe, showing image, title, description, tags, and a save/unset button.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the recipe card, including image, text, tags, and save button, with navigation to recipe detail page.
